name: Mudd Winter 2019
information: All competitors should be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If this is your first competition, [this video](https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww) provides an excellent overview of how the competition will run. **Events:** Please note that 3x3 Blindfolded is tentative and will only be held if time allows. **Staff:** We will make periodic announcements for help with judging, scrambling, and data entry. If you are able to, we ask that you volunteer to help the competition run smoothly.
